notes: A round-based chase with one pursuer and four pursued is Survival's asymmetric 1 vs All case, not Party & Casual tag, because the pressure is a killer and the round is survived rather than scored. warren-looping is the shape that format requires: a tight arena of interconnected loops with zero dead ends so a fleeing player is never cornered by pathfinding, and its P6 stands — the topology is the game, so it is generated procedurally and dressed after rather than left to an image. spawn-protected separates the chaser's start from the survivors', and cover-los gives the crawlspaces and lockers a chase and jumpscare game needs. Decided without a user: the preset's gate-escape is dropped because the author said rounds end on the timer or on everyone being caught, so there is no exit to reach; the arena is kept tight and plainly blocky per the answers, and Verity, Falsity and Creator are character models with animations and abilities, none of which the layout expresses.
